user.description: Add Night Compensation. Zones are added afterwards, from the integration page.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Night Compensation is already set up.

lights.title: Light limits
lights.description: Maximum and minimum brightness per light, as % of its full brightness.

error.light_in_other_zone: One of these lights already belongs to another zone.
error.lux_sensor_required: Choose a lux sensor, or use the sun as source.

set_override.name: Set override
set_override.description: Override one or more zones, for example for visitors.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: boost: stay at the boost peak; max: 100 %; level: a set level; pause: leave the lights alone.

until.name: Until
until.description: next_phase, the next solar noon, or after a duration. Sleep mode always ends boost, max and level.

clear_override.name: Clear override
clear_override.description: Back to automatic; also ends manual pauses.
